reason: A multi-platform messaging integration for DeepSeek Harness that receives and sends agent messages through Feishu, Telegram, Discord, or WeCom with capability-aware formatting and delivery handling.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书、Telegram、Discord 和企业微信等平台，实现消息接收、智能体回复发送及能力降级处理。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Feishu, Telegram, Discord, and WeCom for receiving messages, sending replies, and adapting to platform capabilities.

capabilities: Connects to Feishu, Telegram, Discord, or WeCom messaging services
Receives inbound messages and forwards them to a DeepSeek Harness agent
Sends agent responses and supported message types to configured platforms
Uses platform credentials and supports webhook or WebSocket connectivity
Handles retries, deduplication, per-chat serialization, and capability-based message degradation
